## Summary

Pellucid Health Inc: accidental drop during transport of a tablet and a drawing display at a hotel meeting room in Leeds. Covered under clause 4.5; reserve 7,762 dollars.

## Facts

Pellucid Health Inc reported the loss on 23 March 2026 [notice of loss]. The loss occurred at a hotel meeting room in Leeds [notice of loss]. The items are a tablet and a drawing display [invoice 1], [invoice 2]. The incident was recorded on 25 March 2026 [incident report].

## Coverage analysis

The loss falls under clause 4.5 of the policy, which covers accidental damage to portable equipment carried between premises [policy]. Exclusion 7.1 does not apply: no theft is alleged [policy].

## Decision

Covered under clause 4.5. The claim is accepted.

## Reserve

The reserve is 7,762 dollars, the sum of the two invoices (4,948 dollars and 2,814 dollars) [invoice 1], [invoice 2]; the schedule applies no excess [policy].
